coverage: Entry Warden and perimeter Sentinel: scene tap plus simultaneous manual MOVE/FIRE drag; both down confirmations. Scene swipe turned 000 to 314.
DASH traversal activated. Warning-turn taps turned rear-right to 084 and later left to 000, followed by fresh actor taps and down confirmations.
All three real recoveries, Custodian II/III/I shutdown, manual TOOLS reload while holding ROUTE, return and full upload.
Ordinary visibly charging Custodian: DASH produced CUSTODIAN PHASE BREAK / COILS OPEN 3s, followed by Coil I shutdown. Terminal phase-evade count remains zero; not conflated with the interrupt.
Deck target selected and TARGET DOWN observed before final upload. Exact actor type not inferred from that generic message.
retainedFriction: Wall-facing triage departure before route turn; small distant patrols and assisted travel still limit the experience.
Elian approach did not finish recovery in the first 2.2-second hold; another 1.2-second hold confirmed all three. The earlier filename elian-recovered.jpg is a label, not proof of recovery.
Coil II first burst left 5%; fresh FIRE finished it. Coil I was occluded from the first firing position, prompting approach plus reload. Shield fell to 31 during boss focus; later regenerated.
unassessed: Natural alternate-dock activation was not established in this portrait run; the reproduced intercepted tap is arranged evidence.
Physical phones, Safari, audio, hardware frame pacing, thumb comfort, human reaction timing, continuous held-burst rearming and sustained enjoyment.
